note: 200 random translations from aliquli, mirali, and ibnkathir

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: So to that (religion of Allah) invite, (O Muḥammad),<{["F", 1]}> and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of scripture (i.e., the Qur’ān), and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.<{["F", 2]}> There is no (need for) argument between us and you.<{["F", 3]}> Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the (final) destination."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And recite, (O Muḥammad), what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Or (it is) like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing<{["F", 1]}> of the disbelievers.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Only those who listen will respond [to _you_]. As for the dead, Allah will resurrect them, then they will be brought back to Him.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: If only the faithless knew of the time when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces and their backs, nor will they be helped!<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Verily, the righteous ones shall drink of a cup tempered at the fountain 'Kafoor' (Camphor)!

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And (to) others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And present to them the example of the life of this world, (its being) like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it<{["F", 1]}> and (then) it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: No! If they were driven out, they will not go out with them, and if they are fought against, they would help them not, and even if they help them, certainly will they turn their backs; then they shall not be helped.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: nor any food except pus,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And indeed, dawned on them in the morn a lasting chastisement

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: When the earth is shaken violently,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Belied (the truth) (the people of) 'Ad, then how (great) was My chastisement and My warning! (Refer to Verse <{["Q", "69:7"]}>.)

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And verily for you there in the cattle is a lesson; We give you to drink what is in their bellies, from betwixt the (Sediment - excrement of the beasts.) faeces and the blood, milk pure, easy and palatable for those who drink (it).

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: in the gardens of bliss,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: These shall be inmates of the garden, abiding in it; a recompense for what they did

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: The people of Lot impugned the apostles

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge (i.e., Paradise).

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And We sent to no city a prophet (who was denied) except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves (to Allah).

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Then (if you had), We would have made you taste double (punishment in) life and double (after) death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And when you, (O Muḥammad), do not bring them a sign (i.e., miracle), they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This (Qur’ān) is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: What! reflect they not that their companion (The Holy Prophet Muhammad.) (Our Apostle Muhammad) is not seized with madness, He is but only a plain Warner.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: As for the wall, it belonged to two boy orphans in the city. Under it there was a treasure belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord desired that they should come of age and take out their treasure —as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do that out of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.'

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: And He dragged down those who had backed them from among the People of the Book from their strongholds, and He cast terror into their hearts, [so that] you killed a part of them, and took captive [another] part of them.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Said they: "O' Salih! Indeed thou wert amongst us in whom (our) hopes were centred before this; Dost thou (now) forbid us from worshipping what our fathers did worship? And verily we are in a disquieting doubt about that unto which thou callest us."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: 'Insert your hand into your bosom. It will emerge white, without any fault, —among nine signs for Pharaoh and his people. Indeed they are a transgressing lot.'

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And most certainly were belied (Our) apostles before thee, but they were patient on their being belied and were persecuted until came to them Our help; and none can alter the words ('Words' stands here for God's will Creative or Legislative. Here refers to the decision about His Prophets. Refer to Verses <{["Q", "58:21"]}>; <{["Q", "37:171"]}>; <{["Q", "37:172"]}>.) of God; And most certainly hath come to thee the tidings about the apostles (from Us) (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "6:116"]}>; <{["Q", "37:171"]}>; <{["Q", "37:172"]}>; <{["Q", "38:21"]}>.) .

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: and do not obey the dictates of the profligate,

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed (i.e., tyrannized)."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: She said, 'Indeed when kings enter a town, they devastate it, and reduce the mightiest of its people to the most abased. That is how they act.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Supplicate your Lord, beseechingly and secretly. Indeed He does not like the transgressors.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And that (incumbent) upon Him is the other (i.e., next) creation.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy,
   and as for the wrongdoers,
   He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And will profit you not my good advice, if I intend to give you good advice if God willeth that He should leave you astray; He is your Lord! and unto Him (only) shall ye be returned.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it<{["F", 1]}> a sign for the worlds.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: They ask not leave of thee, who believe in God and the Last Day (of Judgment) (to be exempt) from striving with their wealth and their selves (Lives.) ; Verily God is the knower of the pious ones.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then when He removes the distress from you, behold, a part of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: But if justice be on their side, they come compliantly to him.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Then their excuse (In Arabic 'Fitna', the mischief of their disbelief will not be there.) would be nothing but that they would say: "By God, Our Lord! we were not polytheists."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Allah has made the Kaʿbah, the Sacred House, standing<{["F", 1]}> for the people and (has sanctified) the sacred months and the sacrificial animals and the garlands (by which they are identified). That is so you may know that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and that Allah is Knowing of all things.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Shall be the food of the sinful,

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Allah wants to make clear to you (the lawful from the unlawful) and guide you to the (good) practices of those before you and to accept your repentance. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: This is the Day of Judgment which ye used to belie

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And when the sky is stripped away.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: —turning to Him in penitence, and be wary of Him, and maintain the prayer, and do not be among the polytheists

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Beware! Verily God's is what soever is in the heavens and the earth; Knoweth He indeed your state; and on the day on which they are returned unto Him, then He will inform them of what they did; and God of everything is well Aware.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: So when they took him (out) and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well...<{["F", 1]}> But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them (someday) about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive (your identity)."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: 'My Lord! Deliver me and my family from what they do.'

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: On the day He will muster them all together, then He will say to the angels, 'Was it you that these used to worship?'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And for every (religious) community We have appointed a rite (of sacrifice)<{["F", 1]}> that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of (sacrificial) animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, (O Muḥammad), give good tidings to the humble (before their Lord).

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: He is indeed avid in the love of wealth.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: as if they had never lived there. Look! Indeed Thamūd defied their Lord. Look! Away with Thamūd!

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And those who race each other in a race.<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Is not that (Creator) Able to give life to the dead?

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And (it teaches) that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When the twin recorders record [his deeds],
 seated on the right hand and on the left:

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
Then We set _you_ upon a clear course of the Law;
  so _follow_ it,
 and _do not follow_ the desires of those
  who do not know.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.<{["F", 1]}> Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: But if they turn away, _say_, 'I have proclaimed to you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been promised is far or near.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And warn them of the intense regret, when the matter shall have been decreed while they are (now) in negligence and they believe not.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: As for those whose deeds weigh light in the scales, —they will be the ones who have ruined their souls, [and] they will remain in hell [forever].

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: They said, 'Indeed we take you for a bad omen. If you do not relinquish we will stone you, and surely a painful punishment will visit you from us.'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses<{["F", 1]}> and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allah.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And it is not for a soul (i.e., anyone) to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement<{["F", 1]}> upon those who will not use reason.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Verily, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and divided its people into parties, weakening a group among them, he slaughtered their sons and spared alive their women; Verily he was of the mischief-makers.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: And beware of the Fire which has been prepared for the faithless,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: 'O' ye who believe! when it is said unto you, 'Make ye room in (your) assemblies! then make ye room, God will make room for you; and when it is said unto you, 'Rise (Get up.) ye up! then rise ye up, God will exalt (you in) ranks (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "4:95"]}>; <{["Q", "6:165"]}>.) (unto Him), those who believe among you, and those who have been granted knowledge; and God is All-Aware of whatsoever ye do (Refer to Verses <{["Q", "3:7"]}>; <{["Q", "3:18"]}>; <{["Q", "4:162"]}>; <{["Q", "29:49"]}>.) .

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, (both) trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different (kinds of) food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of (each of) its fruit when it yields and give its due (zakāh) on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive.<{["F", 1]}> Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then We will surely recount to them with knowledge, for We had not been absent.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: That which is with you will be spent but what is with Allah shall last, and We will surely pay the patient their reward by the best of what they used to do.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: We too will summon the Angels of the Hell (to punish)

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: The likenesses of pearls well-protected.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: (Therein are) gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: and left for them a good name in posterity.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And these similitudes We do set forth unto people, but understand them none but the learned (ones)

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When they are told,
 'Do not cause corruption on the earth,'
  they say, 'We are only reformers!'

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: All praise belongs to Allah, who, despite [my] old age, gave me Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed my Lord hears all supplications.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And your god is one God. There is no deity (worthy of worship) except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Claiming him who turned his back and went away (from the Truth)

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: So he abandoned them [to their fate], and said, 'O my people! Certainly I communicated to you the message of my Lord, and I was your well-wisher, but you did not like well-wishers.'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs<{["F", 1]}> - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And certainly did We send Musa with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And We sent not any apostle but with the language (Indicates that every nation or people on earth had their warner, apostles, who preached the truth to them in their respective languages.) of the people that he might clearly explain (Our commandments) unto them; then God leaveth to stray whom He willeth and guideth He whom He willeth, and He is the Mighty the Wise.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings (i.e., screened) from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;<{["F", 1]}> indeed, we are working."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
Certainly Allah has fulfilled His Apostle's vision
   in all truth:
  You will surely enter the Sacred Mosque,
   God willing,
    in safety,
  with your heads shaven or hair cropped,
   without any fear.
 So He knew what you did not know,
  and He assigned [you] besides that
    a victory near at hand.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Those who spend their wealth by night (Ali Ibn Abi Talib used to approach the needy and the poor, night and day and provided them with the necessities, So did the other Imams of the Ahl Al-Bayt.) and (by) day, secretly and openly, for them shall be their reward with their Lord, fear shall not be on them nor shall they grieve

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Said they (The King's servants.) : "We miss the king's drinking cup and whosoever bringeth it, shall have a camel load (of corn); and I am responsible for it."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: So if they believe in the like of what you believe in, then they are certainly guided; and if they turn away, then they are only [steeped] in defiance. Allah shall suffice _you_ against them, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Allah has already given you victory in many regions and (even) on the day of Ḥunayn, when your great number pleased you, but it did not avail you at all, and the earth was confining for you with (i.e., in spite of) its vastness; then you turned back, fleeing.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And he gathered (his people) and called out.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: and left for him a good name in posterity:

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And every man's destiny (Arabic 'Taa'ir' i.e., deeds wrought by the individual.) We have caused to cling to his neck; and We will bring forth unto him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: O you who have faith! Remember Allah's blessing upon you when the hosts came at you, and We sent against them a gale and hosts whom you did not see. And Allah sees best what you do.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then his people came running toward him, and they had been committing vices aforetime. He said, 'O my people, these are my daughters: they are purer for you.<{["F", 1]}> Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me with regard to my guests. Is there not a right-minded man among you?'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And if only they had upheld (the law of) the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to them from their Lord (i.e., the Qur’ān), they would have consumed (provision) from above them and from beneath their feet.<{["F", 1]}> Among them are a moderate (i.e., acceptable) community, but many of them - evil is that which they do.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And We delivered them both and their people from the great distress

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: for what sin she was killed.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When you see them, their bodies impress you,
  and if they speak, _you_ listen to their speech.
 Yet they are like dry logs set reclining [against a wall]. They suppose every cry is directed against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them.
 May Allah assail them, where do they stray?!

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement and made me one of the apostles.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then Satan tempted them, to expose to them what was hidden from them of their nakedness, and he said, 'Your Lord has only forbidden you from this tree lest you should become angels, or lest you become immortal.'

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Be it known, verily, the friends of God, no fear shall (does not overtake them.) be on them, nor do they grieve.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And the people of the Left hand, Ah! What (a wretched state shall) the people of the Left hand (be in)!

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: So revealed We unto him that: "Make thou (O' Our Apostle Noah!) the Ark before Our eyes and (as per) Our revelation (Direction.) and when cometh (unto thee) Our command, and gusheth forth water from the oven, take into it two of every species a pair and thy people except those among them about whom had already been issued the word; and address (Pray not – wish not.) Me not in respect of those who are unjust; for verily they shall be drowned."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: (Musa) said, "My Lord, expand (i.e., relax) for me my breast (with assurance).

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Except for those who take refuge with a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty or those who come to you, their hearts strained at (the prospect of) fighting you or fighting their own people. And if Allah had willed, He could have given them power over you, and they would have fought you. So if they remove themselves from you and do not fight you and offer you peace, then Allah has not made for you a cause (for fighting) against them.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: by the sky and Him who built it,

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Fie on you and on what ye worship besides God. What! Do ye not understand?

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When Moses said to his people,
 'O my people! Why do you torment me,
  when you certainly know
   that I am Allah's apostle to you?' So when they swerved [from the right path]
  Allah made their hearts swerve,
 and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating (in prayer), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration (i.e., prayer). That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He (i.e., Allah) may enrage by them<{["F", 1]}> the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And the heaven will split (open), for that Day it is infirm.<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And ye covered not yourselves (merely) lest that your ears and your eyes and your skins should bear witness against you, but (it was) that ye thought that God knoweth not most of what ye did.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
He is Allah—there is no god except Him—
  the Sovereign, the All-holy,
  the All-benign,<{["F", 1]}> the Securer, the All-conserver,
  the All-mighty, the All-compeller,
   the All-magnanimous.
  Clear is Allah
  of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then he made an observation of the stars<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: and for their saying, 'We killed the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, the apostle of Allah' —though they did not kill him nor did they crucify him, but so it was made to appear to them. Indeed those who differ concerning him<{["F", 1]}> are surely in doubt about him:<{["F", 2]}> they do not have any knowledge of that beyond following conjectures, and certainly they did not kill him.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
A description of the paradise
   promised to the Godwary:
  therein are streams of unstaling water,
  and streams of milk unchanging in flavour,
  and streams of wine delicious to the drinkers,
  and streams of purified honey;
  there will be for them every kind of fruit in it,
   and forgiveness from their Lord.
 [Are such ones] like those who abide in the Fire
  and are given to drink boiling water
   which cuts up their bowels?

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Allah bears witness that there is no god except Him —and [so do] the angels and those who possess knowledge— maintainer of justice, there is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-wise.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Around shall go about (serving) them youths of unchanging bloom (Refer to Verse <{["Q", "52:24"]}>.)

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And ye hew out of the mountains for dwellings (for you), exaltingly

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And (mention) the man of the fish (i.e., Yunus), when he went off in anger<{["F", 1]}> and thought that We would not decree (anything) upon him.<{["F", 2]}> And he called out within the darknesses,<{["F", 3]}> "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: But if bounty comes to you from Allah, he will surely say, as if (i.e., showing that) there had never been between you and him any affection, "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Already the word (i.e., decree) has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allah, excluding the (other) people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Then they (the magicians) disputed about their affair among themselves and they spake apart in secret.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Our Lord, and make us Muslims (in submission) to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation (in submission) to You. And show us our rites (of worship) and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: (That) indeed, they would be those given victory.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: ''On the day on which shall quake (Commotion convulsion.) the quaking

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: It is He who shows you the lightning, inspiring fear and hope, and He produces the clouds heavy [with rain].

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: The scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Then two men of those who feared (God), and upon whom both, God hath bestowed His) favour: "Enter ye upon them (suddenly) by the gate (of the city); for (once) ye have entered it, Verily, (ye shall see) ye are victorious, and upon God ye should rely, if ye be (true) believers."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Allah alternates the night and the day. There is indeed a moral in that for those who have insight.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good and verily turneth he unto God a (sincere) turning,

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Indeed We have sent _you_ with the truth, as a bearer of good news and as a warner, and _you_ will not be questioned concerning the inmates of hell.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah
  and whatever there is in the earth,
 the Sovereign, the All-holy,
 the All-mighty, the All-wise.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And if We will, We would certainly put (Make blind.) out their eyes, then they would struggle (groping) to get first to the way, but how could they see?

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: 'O Abraham, let this matter alone! Your Lord's edict has certainly come, and an irrevocable punishment shall overtake them.'

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth; and whether you disclose what is in your hearts or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whomever He wishes and punish whomever He wishes, and Allah has power over all things.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When _your_ Lord said to the angels,
 'Indeed I am going to set a viceroy on the earth,'
 they said, 'Will You set in it
  someone who will cause corruption in it,
   and shed blood,
  while we celebrate Your praise
   and proclaim Your sanctity?'
 He said, 'Indeed I know what you do not know.'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Say to those who have disbelieved (that) if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return (to hostility) - then the precedent of the former (rebellious) peoples has already taken place.<{["F", 1]}>

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: That you (people) may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect him (i.e., the Prophet SAW) and exalt Him (i.e., Allah) morning and afternoon.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: exalted and purified,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Verily those who disbelieve spend of their wealth to obstruct (men) from the way of God, so will they spend it, then (in the end) it shall be against them (a matter of) regret; and those who disbelieve, unto the Hell shall they be driven.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement!

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
reclining therein on couches.
   They will find in it neither any [scorching] sun,
     nor any [biting] cold.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And said the king "Verily, I did see in (dream) seven fat kine which seven lean ones devoured, and seven green ears and (seven) others dry; O' chiefs (of my court)! Explain (Opine.) ye unto me my dream, if ye can interpret a dream."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you, but do not transgress. Indeed Allah does not like transgressors.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: —[all are such] except the prayerful,

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And shall be brought together the sun and the moon

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And remember Allah during (specific) numbered days. Then whoever hastens (his departure) in two days - there is no sin upon him; and whoever delays (until the third) - there is no sin upon him - for him who fears Allah. And fear Allah and know that unto Him you will be gathered.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: They will not hear even its faint sound and they will remain [forever] in what their souls desire.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Ta Ha. (T. H.)

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: When he had furnished them with their provision, he said, 'Bring me a brother that you have through your father. Do you not see that I give the full measure and that I am the best of hosts?

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: They know (only) the appearance of the life of this world, while of the hereafter they are heedless. (Inattentive.)

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: And _you_ will see the angels surrounding the Throne, celebrating the praise of their Lord, and judgment will be made between them with justice, and it will be said, 'All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!'

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: God admonisheth you that ye return not unto the like of it for ever, if ye be believers.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: He said, 'It really upsets me that you should take him away, and I fear the wolf may eat him while you are oblivious of him.'

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: O you who have faith! Do not approach prayer when you are intoxicated, [not] until you know what you are saying, nor [enter mosques] in the state of ritual impurity —except while passing through— until you have washed yourselves. But if you are sick or on a journey, or any of you has come from the toilet, or you have touched women,<{["F", 1]}> and you cannot find water, then make your ablution on clean ground and wipe a part of your faces and your hands. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: On the straight path

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And if someone is in hardship, then (let there be) postponement until (a time of) ease. But if you give (from your right as) charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And indeed We distribute (Lit. 'Sarrasnah' displayed - but the display of the water among mankind is distributing it between them – This stands for the display or the divine grace for the benefit of mankind.) it (water) to them that they may be (thankfully) mindful, but content not the great number of the people but to be thankless.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Said they: "O' Noah! indeed hast thou disputed with us and thou hast prolonged the dispute with us, now bring thou unto us what thou hast threatened (The wrath of God.) us with, if thou art of the truthful ones."

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving (help) to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Said (Moses): "They are close on my track and I hastened unto Thee O' my Lord! that thou mightest be well pleased (with me)!"

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: He is Allah, the Creator,<{["F", 1]}> the Producer,<{["F", 2]}> the Fashioner;<{["F", 3]}> to Him belong the best names.<{["F", 4]}> Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.<{["F", 5]}>

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And the tall palm-trees with fruit-stalks, closely set one above another,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: Then let him summon his fellows in council

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
But when We lifted the punishment from them,
 behold, they would break their pledge.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: (He is) Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: To the Jews We forbade every animal having an undivided hoof, and of oxen and sheep We forbade them their fat, except what is borne by their backs or the entrails or what is attached to the bones. We requited them with that for their rebelliousness, and We indeed speak the truth.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Then it appeared to them,<{["F", 1]}> after they had seen all the signs [of his innocence], that they should confine him for some time.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And verily this your group is one group, and I am your Lord therefore fear ye (Only Me).

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs],

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And He made you to inherit their land and their dwellings and their properties, and a land (Refer to verses <{["Q", "59:2"]}> - <{["Q", "59:7"]}>.) which ye have not yet set your foot; And God is Powerful over all things.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: There had certainly come to them an apostle from among themselves, but they impugned him, so the punishment seized them while they were wrongdoers.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text:
When Our signs are recited to him,
   he says, 'Myths of the ancients!'

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down,<{["F", 1]}> "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: So We expelled them from gardens and springs,

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And nothing prevented the people from believing, when came unto them the guidance (from their Lord), save that they said: "What! hath God sent a man (like unto us to be) (His) Apostle."

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Both gardens yielded their produce without stinting anything of it. And We had set a stream gushing through them.

texts.author: aliquli
texts.text: Every soul shall taste death, and We will test you with good and ill by way of test, and to Us you will be brought back.

texts.author: mirali
texts.text: And keep (Protect.) them from evil: and whomsoever keepest thou from evil, this day indeed Thou hast bestowed mercy on him, and that, it is a Mighty Achievement.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in (joyful) occupation.

texts.author: ibnkathir
texts.text: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
